album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 6

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on F#4 and dwells most on F# in Sufiname. The line peaks at A4 (436.4 Hz) at 0:21.8. It closes on C#4, not the tonic (Ds4 → Dk4 → C#4 → F#4 → F#4 → C#4).
